title: Tencent’s AI Innovation Pace in Question After Earnings
summary: Investors seek evidence of Tencent closing the gap on AI leaders

title: AI Is Creating a New Path for Musical Stardom, With Uncertain Staying Power
summary: Are AI-aided music creators like “Saxboy Billy” one-hit wonders?

title: Super Micro Gives Sales Outlook That Tops Rosiest Projection
summary: Super Micro Computer Inc. gave a revenue forecast for the current quarter that topped analysts’ estimates, a sign the booming artificial intelligence market continues to bolster sales of the company’s servers.

title: Wintermute Plans $1 Billion AI Investment to Compete on Wall Street
summary: Wintermute Trading Ltd. intends to invest about $1 billion in high-frequency trading and artificial intelligence data center infrastructure over the next five years, as the digital assets market maker looks to diversify into traditional markets following a slump in crypto.

title: New York City Probes Prediction Markets Over Ads, Social Harms
summary: The New York City Council is probing the advertising practices of four major prediction market platforms, creating a new front in the legal battles facing the booming industry.

title: AI Coding Startup Lovable Raises $400 Million at $13.3 Billion Valuation
summary: Swedish coding startup Lovable has raised funding at a $13.3 billion valuation, bringing in fresh capital to compete with larger rivals like Anthropic and Elon Musk’s SpaceX.

title: Tencent Sustains Revenue Growth to Bankroll Costly AI Investment
summary: Tencent Holdings Ltd.’s revenue grew a faster-than-projected 11%, keeping up the steady pace of expansion it needs to finance a costly AI services and infrastructure buildout.

title: Tech Investments Boost Norway's Sovereign Wealth Fund
summary: Norway's sovereign wealth fund delivered its strongest quarterly performance in six years, driven by its exposure to major technology companies including Nvidia Corp., Apple Inc., and Microsoft Corp. Additionally, the fund's CEO Nicolai Tangen highlighted the positive impact of Asian tech stocks on overall profits. Bloomberg'sHeidi Taksdal Skjeseth reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia Partner Hon Hai Scores Profit Beat on AI Spending Surge
summary: Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. reported a better-than-expected increase in quarterly profit, signaling robust global demand for AI hardware.

title: CoreWeave Shares Soar After Booming AI Demand Boosts Outlook
summary: CoreWeave Inc., a provider of computing that powers artificial intelligence systems, surged in premarket trading after the AI spending frenzy spurred faster sales growth than anticipated.

title: Zetwerk Is Said to Plan Public Filing for $400 Million India IPO
summary: Zetwerk Pvt., an Indian contract manufacturer, is preparing to publicly file for an initial public offering that could raise as much as $400 million, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Ex-Alibaba AI Architect Wins Tencent, HSG Backing for New Lab
summary: The former architect of Alibaba Group Holding Ltd.’s flagship model has founded a startup to build AI agents, securing backing from Tencent Holdings Ltd. and Chinese venture heavyweights.

title: Stocks Rise as CoreWeave, Super Micro Boost AI Trade
summary: Asian stocks rose and US equity-index futures advanced as CoreWeave reported stronger-than-expected sales growth and Super Micro's revenue forecast topped estimates. Bloomberg's Neil Campling reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Vacuum Pump Makers, Producers of Gases Are the New AI Winners
summary: European makers of vacuum pumps, heat exchangers and specialty gases are cementing their spot as lesser-known winners of the artificial-intelligence boom, creating new opportunities for investors wary of more established AI stocks.

title: Peak Memory Fears Put Focus on Samsung, SK Hynix Cash Returns
summary: Memory-chip makers may have found a new defense against the inevitable cooling of their boom: giving more cash back to shareholders.

title: Chinese AI Upstart Manus Charts Solo Path After Meta Split
summary: Manus, a Chinese-founded artificial intelligence startup, will resume independent operations as it parts ways with Meta Platforms Inc. after Beijing blocked a landmark takeover that highlighted the risks facing local entrepreneurs expanding globally.

title: AI Startup Cognition in New Funding Talks at $40 Billion Value
summary: Cognition AI is in early talks with investors for a new funding round that may boost the coding startup’s valuation by more than 50% to at least $40 billion, people familiar with the matter said.

title: Wall Street Helps Ease Concern Over Nvidia's Circular Financing
summary: Neil Shah, Vice President at Counterpoint, discusses the outlook for Nvidia Corp. and the circular deals underpinning the AI boom. He speaks with Shery Ahn on Bloomberg: The Asia Trade. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: AAPA on Asia's Airline Industry, Passenger Demand
summary: Wong Hong, Director General at the Association of Asia Pacific Airlines, discusses the outlook for the region's carriers and the impact from higher jet fuel prices on passenger demand. He speaks with Haidi Stroud-Watts on Bloomberg: The Asia Trade. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: South Korea's AI Investment Plans
summary: South Korea expects to deploy more than 1 trillion won in fresh capital next year into a new sovereign wealth fund targeting AI and other strategic industries, Min Kyung-seol, the country's deputy finance minister for innovation and growth, tells Bloomberg Television's Shery Ahn in an exclusive interview. (Source: Bloomberg)
